title: Clearer buy costs
text: The buy sheet splits the cost to get in into price impact, fees, tax and the route; a curve's fee counts once

title: MEV protection on Solana
text: Solana trades go out privately with a small tip set by speed, away from sandwich bots

title: Your quick buy amounts
text: Set the four quick buy amounts in the menu

title: Buy buttons on request
text: On a coin's page the buy amounts show after you tap Buy, so a stray tap buys nothing

title: Trade details
text: Each trade in Activity, failed ones too, opens a page with what it cost, its route and its transactions

title: Both sides for every wallet
text: A wallet imported from one key can create or import its missing EVM or Solana address
